Messages.Author: Max
Messages.Body:
When Ezmeralda is removed from the game to activate her special,what
happens to the cards on her? Are they removed from the game or burned
to the ash-heap?

Thank you.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


"When a card is burned or removed from the game, any counters or other cards
on it are burned." [1.1.2]
